TermGPTRemoteDesktop is a separate GPL-3.0-or-later executable.
Includes FreeRDP 3.32.1 (Apache-2.0), LibVNCClient 0.9.15 (GPL-2.0-or-later), and OpenSSL 3.6.5 (Apache-2.0).
The corresponding source archive is supplied alongside TermGPT releases. Source URLs and verified hashes are recorded in dependencies.json.
FreeRDP: https://github.com/FreeRDP/FreeRDP
LibVNC: https://github.com/LibVNC/libvncserver
OpenSSL: https://github.com/openssl/openssl
No warranty is provided. See the included license texts.
